items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: these other jobs like the Cajun and Arthur’s, yes I bring it in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. I actually work more as a piano player these days, and I play the Hotel Utica, and I literally can leave my house 15 minutes before the job, and unless I run into a stoplight I can sit down at the piano in time to start. But for you, with a drumset, to go into Manhattan—
No the drumset’s there. Oh, oh, these other jobs like the Cajun and Arthur’s, yes I bring it in there. That’s a struggle.
Yeah. Finding a parking spot and all that. You probably have to leave like—
